{{Quote|Welcome! I am Major Caleb Knolar. Are you here to make a monetary donation to the war effort?|Major Caleb Knolar, to an Imperial sympathizer|<ref name="SWG:MCK" />}}
'''Caleb Knolar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Imperial officer|officer]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He collected [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credit]] contributions from those sympathetic to the Empire.

==Biography==
{{Quote|On behalf of the Emperor, I hereby grant you the title 'Patron of the Empire'.|Major Caleb Knolar, to an Imperial sympathizer|<ref name="SWG:MCK" />}}
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[Major/Legends|Major]] Caleb Knolar was stationed at a [[Imperial garrison (Bestine)|small Imperial garrison]] in the [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooinian]] capital of [[Bestine (city)/Legends|Bestine]]. It was at this location that Caleb Knolar accepted [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credit]] donations from various sources to support the war effort.<ref name="SWG:MCK" /> During [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> he received at least one generous donation of one million credits from an unknown [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]]. Caleb commended this individual's generosity by acknowledging him as a "Patron of the Empire".<ref name="SWG:MCK" />

==Behind the scenes==
Caleb Knolar was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:MCK" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Major Caleb Knolar was added to the game with the release of the [[W:c:swg:Game Update 9|Game Update 9]], on [[April 30]], [[2009]]. He was one of the three NPCs (along with [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lt.]] [[Jarad Gastin]] and [[Ozzmos Roberts]]) added with the update that were used as [[:wikipedia:Gold sink|credit sinks]] to remove money from the game economy and combat inflation.<ref name="GU9">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=908618|text=Star Wars Galaxies: Game Update 9}}</ref> For paying one million credits, the player received the player title "Patron of the Empire."<ref name="SWG:MCK" />
